hypothesis: The v3 robust frontier (19/30) still fails three cash-back rewards-correction tasks (task_020, task_022, task_029) because the agent cannot reliably identify which of a customer's credit-card transactions earned the wrong cash back. The iter1/2 internal_procedure_channel loads the cash-back KB docs into the system prompt and the iter5 cashback_stage_state_advisor surfaces the Stage 1 / Stage 2 ordering at the workflow entry-point, but neither solves the arithmetic. Rho-Bank cash back depends on (1) a per-card qualifying/standard rate split, (2) published merchant-exclusion lists on two cards, and (3) limited-time promo multipliers gated by a window keyed to the account-opening date. Two transactions on the same card, category and rate can be one an error and one correct (e.g. two Business Silver Travel transactions, one inside the 2x promo window and one outside) — that is not a reasoning gap, it is a documented domain policy waiting to be compiled. Compiling that policy into a deterministic engine that annotates each credit_card_transaction_history tool result with the policy-verified error set gives the LLM an exact dispute list and lifts train-30 reward on task_020 / task_022 / task_029 without affecting tasks that don't request a cash-back review (the engine only annotates results containing credit-card transaction records).

The predicate inspects only the framework-emitted structured tool-response content — never user message text, never task structure, never an observed failure event. The promo-window resolution side-channel inspects every prior tool message whose content contains the literal substring 'date_of_account_open' and extracts (card_type, opened) pairs — again, only structured tool-response content.

The engine parses these keys from the framework-emitted record blocks; on a fresh task suite written against the same db.py the parser activates on the same content. The credit_card_accounts schema (date_of_account_open) is the same fact for the promo-window side-channel. The published rounding rule (int truncation, ±1 tolerance) is the documented Credit Card Rewards Points Rounding Policy (doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_007). (2) Published Rho-Bank policy tables: the per-card rate, qualifying-category set, merchant-exclusion list and promo-window rule are read from the KB's per-product spec docs (doc_credit_cards_*_001.json) — the same docs the iter3 card_spec_channel already surfaces to the LLM verbatim. The engine compiles these tables; the rule per transaction is then the documented arithmetic correct_points = int(amount * rate * promo_multiplier). (b) HONEST classification: this is induced_rule because the rate / category / exclusion / promo tables encode the builder's reading of those KB docs. The HIGH-risk gate: [#1 ≥3 evidence simulations] satisfied — task_020, task_022, task_029 (plus 026, 027 cross-evidence). [#2 No low-risk fix available] the relevant KB docs are already in the system prompt by the iter1/2 internal_procedure_channel and surfaced as structured spec sheets by the iter3 card_spec_channel; the LLM still cannot reliably do the per-transaction arithmetic across many transactions in a single turn — across 8 train cash-back tasks the iter9 frontier mis-identifies the dispute set even with the docs in hand. [#3 Non-destructive deployment] the engine only ever appends advisory text to a tool result; it never adds/blocks/reorders/rewrites a tool call. The engine is built to never over-flag: when category (no category recorded), merchant qualification (no exclusion list match), or the promo window (account-open date not yet observed) cannot be resolved, both documented rates / multipliers are accepted, so a true cash-back error is required to flag. A plausible out-of-evidence misfire: a future card / category combination outside the compiled tables — the engine returns 'skip' for unknown cards and only accepts both rates for unknown categories, so the worst case is a missed flag (status quo), not a false positive. A model that consistently identifies the exact error set unaided makes the annotation redundant but never harmful.
plugin.fallback: If the credit_card_transaction_history record format changes (key rename or removal), the parser yields zero records and audit_transaction_list returns None — the agent behaves identically to its inherited parent (iter7 ClosureCliPrereqAdvisorAgent). If credit_card_accounts no longer includes date_of_account_open, the promo-window side-channel yields an empty open_dates dict; the engine then accepts both base and promo multipliers (never flags). If a card_type is outside CARD_RATES, the engine returns 'skip' for that transaction. If transaction_amount or rewards_earned cannot be parsed as numeric, the engine returns 'skip'. All exceptions inside _collect_open_dates are caught and reduce to an empty open_dates; the rest of the agent runs unchanged. The MARKER guards the annotation from being applied twice to the same tool message.

plugin.generalization_argument: (a) Stable structure captured (two layers, both independent of the failed simulations): (1) KB document-id partition by product prefix — doc_(business_)?credit_cards_<product>_<NNN>.json is the KB's filesystem layout convention. The set of card-product prefixes is enumerable from disk; a small explicit set of non-product prefixes ({credit_cards_(general), credit_card_account_logistics, credit_card_replacements, virtual_card_management}) excludes the cross-cutting procedure / feature groups that share the credit-card parent prefix but are not card products. (2) Sequential authoring convention — _001.json is the Getting Started / Eligibility spec sheet (base rate, annual fee, APR, fxn fee, credit-limit range, Rho-Bank+ subscription requirement); _002.json is the first follow-on doc for the product and, for almost every revenue-bearing card, the bonus-category earning doc (Silver _002 'How to Earn 4% Cash Back on Travel and Software Purchases'; Platinum _002 'Earning 4% Cash Back'; Bronze _002 'Understanding Your 1% Cash Back Rewards'; Business Silver _002 'How to Earn 10% Back on Travel and Software Purchases'; Business Platinum _002 'Earning 4% Cash Back'). Both suffixes are deterministic ordering properties of the KB layout, not properties of any task. On a freshly authored KB under the same conventions, the rule yields the same class of documents with no reference to any specific failure. (b) N/A — this is a channel, not an induced rule. The catalog contains spec sheets verbatim; the LLM still decides which card matches the customer's stated requirements and whether to recommend at all. The catalog cannot silently override an LLM decision because it never asserts a verdict; it only supplies content. Deployment is non-destructive: the catalog is appended to system_prompt; no tool call is suppressed, rewritten, or fabricated.
plugin.fallback: If the KB documents directory cannot be located or no qualifying products are found, build_catalog() returns the empty string and the agent's system prompt is identical to its iter13 parent. If a product has _001 but no _002, only _001 is loaded for that product (the anchor doc is the minimum). Per-document content is capped at 2200 chars so one pathological doc cannot blow up the prompt. A mis-fire (e.g. a future product where _002 is a non-rate doc, or a future product accidentally tagged under one of these prefixes) only adds or omits reference text and cannot cause a wrong tool call. Any exception during catalog construction is caught at __init__ and self._card_catalog is left as the empty string.
plugin.dead_when: (1) If a future LLM consistently retrieves the same per-product _001 and _002 docs via KB_search and recommends correctly on every card-recommendation task — verifiable by examining tool_calls for KB_search hits on the per-product _001 and _002 docs in passing simulations — the injection becomes redundant. Even then it is not negative because the documents ARE the authoritative spec sheets the agent is supposed to consult. (2) If the KB is restructured so the bonus-rate info moves out of _002 to a different suffix (e.g. all rate info consolidated into _001), the _002 portion of the catalog becomes noise but is still factual reference text and cannot cause a wrong tool call; the channel should then be re-validated.
